Lightning Velo Saturday Ride

Long Beach, CA · East Long Beach

Beginner friendly

Lightning Velo Saturday Ride is a road group ride in Long Beach, CA. It meets every Saturday, 8:00 am (also Sunday 8:00 am), starting at Marina Dr parking lot (temporary start during Studebaker Rd construction). Pace: A 23+ mph, B 19–22 (no drop), C 15–18 (no drop), D 10–15 developmental.

About the Lightning Velo Saturday Ride group ride

Road club with four groups rolling every Saturday and Sunday morning. B and C groups are no-drop double pacelines; the D group is for newer road riders and covers skills and rules of the road. Rides end at a coffee shop in Seal Beach.
